lineage.description: The World Bank developed probabilistic flood hazard models for Cap Haitien, generating inundation extent shapefiles at 5-, 25-, and 100-year return periods. The dataset represents simulated flood extents derived from hydrological and hydraulic modeling, with elevation data included to characterize flood depths across the urban area.
